select tt.task_ope_staff_id taskOpeStaffId, tf.flgt_flno flgtFlno, tf.flgt_regn flgtRegn, tf.flgt_placecode flgtPlacecode, tfr.flrc_figuars taskTotalFuel, counts.countTaskOpeStaffId taskCentTank from T_TASK tt LEFT JOIN T_FUEL_RECPT tfr ON tfr.flrc_no = tt.task_fuel_recpt_no LEFT JOIN T_FLIGHT tf on tf.flgt_id = tt.task_flight_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.taskOpeStaffId taskOpeStaffId, COUNT(a.taskOpeStaffId) countTaskOpeStaffId FROM (SELECT tt.task_ope_staff_id taskOpeStaffId FROM T_TASK tt WHERE DATE_FORMAT(tt.task_done_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = curdate() AND tt.task_status = 7 and tt.task_airport_code = #{flgtAirportCode}) a GROUP BY a.taskOpeStaffId HAVING COUNT(a.taskOpeStaffId)) counts on counts.taskOpeStaffId = tt.task_ope_staff_id where DATE_FORMAT(tt.task_done_time, '%Y-%m-%d') = curdate() and tt.task_status = 7 and tt.task_airport_code = #{flgtAirportCode} ORDER BY counts.countTaskOpeStaffId, tt.task_ope_staff_id desc
